duties.diagramLabel: macOS development is a first-class modern C contract
duties.concreteBoundary: Cold, no-change, leaf, shared-macro, failure/cancel and first-output behavior need separate acceptance
duties.encodingRule: Use phase cost and invalidation identities rather than language substitution or more wrapper layers
duties.cleanControl: Historical receipts bind tool/profile/source/sample; no current build is executed
duties.failureMapping: A model count or cache HIT cannot replace whole-request and semantic acceptance
duties.reflectionDuty: Modernization architecture and work inequalities are design-only; platform causality and speedup remain open
duties.benefitBoundary: Require removed repeated work to exceed validation plus added support; preserve mandatory effects

duties.diagramLabel: Do not conflate Scheme expansion, C provenance and first-output latency
duties.concreteBoundary: Historical large object 15.45 to 10.37 seconds; 8915 to 97 MiB GCC allocation with exact object parity
duties.encodingRule: Separate C macro diagnostic provenance from Scheme expansion and interface construction; first-output ceilings are not mandated sleeps
duties.cleanControl: Darwin/GNU historical profile only; current code/toolchains and whole-build gains are unqualified
duties.failureMapping: Reader-only, scheduling-only or universal five-second cooldown attribution is unsupported
duties.reflectionDuty: Other receipts narrow startup/reader attribution; no platform-wide causal fraction proved
duties.benefitBoundary: Retain low-risk configured provenance policy; structural lowering must remove repeated front-end work

duties.diagramLabel: Move invariant ABI work out of per-module macro expansion
duties.concreteBoundary: PCH was rejected by per-module GLOCOUNT; larger header caching alone did not qualify
duties.encodingRule: Generate explicit per-module descriptors/constants and isolate invariant runtime ABI/helpers; keep Scheme tail/GC/frame semantics
duties.cleanControl: C header/module boundary, debug diagnostics and target configuration need independent parity; no C++ required
duties.failureMapping: Blind PCH, inline-everything, unqualified LLVM switch or lossy source maps cannot claim root fix
duties.reflectionDuty: Frame/root ABI, runtime call cost and actual reduced preprocessing require future design/refinement and matched evidence
duties.benefitBoundary: Can reduce repeated token work while adding helper calls/descriptors; quantify both and retire old macros by role

duties.diagramLabel: One validated native request must remove duplicate preparation
duties.concreteBoundary: Existing scheduler already submits objects; all-hit coordinator regressed 0.88 to 1.59 seconds pair means
duties.encodingRule: Reuse scoped immutable tool/config/input snapshot without double preparation; phase/member invalidation and required effects stay bound
duties.cleanControl: One-change member result is separate from stable HIT/cold; do not revive unchanged denied coordinator
duties.failureMapping: All-hit status, extra workers or repeated tool hashing is not a gain; unknown inputs deny reuse
duties.reflectionDuty: Actual snapshot issuer, transitive reads, mutation rejection and net request work remain unqualified
duties.benefitBoundary: Modern C service should retire old preparation paths rather than wrap them; no duplicate C/Zig maintenance default

duties.diagramLabel: Developer gain requires bounded work, latency and memory across real scenarios
duties.concreteBoundary: Historical one-change gain coexists with slower stable HIT and unqualified whole-consumer gates
duties.encodingRule: Model DAG invalidation, CPU/memory budgets, critical path and failure custody; select existing process/context isolation until shared-VM SMP qualified
duties.cleanControl: Cold/no-change/leaf/shared macro/tool change/failure/cancel plus semantic outputs and real first progress remain distinct
duties.failureMapping: Do not add nested timings, turn a deadline observation into first-log time, or report component gains as package speedup
duties.reflectionDuty: Existing ten-node to 74-action refinement and native performance still open; QNT work projection is not timing evidence
duties.benefitBoundary: AOT construction programs may share code while contexts remain fresh; necessary instantiation and root work cannot vanish

duties.diagramLabel: Attribute the actual modern-C bootstrap critical path
duties.concreteBoundary: Successful whole465.719s, from-scratch366.941s, make-j12/GAMBOPTp1. Top-level commands393.236s; residual72.483s remains unattributed. Configured FLAGS_OBJ lacks macro-tracking-zero
duties.encodingRule: Separate two target passes, Scheme generation, C preprocessing/parsing/codegen, linking, artifact custody and supervisor latency; 600 is a ceiling, never a latency objective
duties.cleanControl: Existing Darwin force/configuration studies already retain macro-tracking-zero; its absence in this modern-c baseline is a configuration-lineage gap. Historical single-object figures cannot predict this whole build or peak RSS
duties.failureMapping: No native compilation occurred in a snapshot-check failure; do not call it a slow bootstrap or erase its denial
duties.reflectionDuty: Per-phase/per-TU time, critical path, CPU utilization, peak RSS and residual attribution remain open until observed
duties.benefitBoundary: Already-parallel work may still repeat or serialize at phase boundaries; CPU count alone cannot establish speedup or memory pressure

duties.diagramLabel: C23 baseline must retire repeated C macro work by responsibility
duties.concreteBoundary: Scheme owns semantics and explicit module/frame plans; stable native ABI/helpers and per-module data have separate dependency identities
duties.encodingRule: Refine the existing ConfiguredNativeModel and M8/E05/E06/E13 obligations, not a new flag table. Common CFLAGS selects C23 for generated C and RTS paths; diagnostic policy is distinct from semantic macro expansion and invariant ABI lowering
duties.cleanControl: Private header organization preserves all public macro text and cannot itself claim reduced front-end work or PCH admission
duties.failureMapping: Do not conflate Scheme macros, C macro token work and GCC diagnostic tracking; do not flatten dynamic-wind, multi-shot continuation, GC roots or source diagnostics
duties.reflectionDuty: Whole-closure callers, layouts, generated metadata and scanner/restore/FFI consumers must migrate before the old macro responsibility retires
duties.benefitBoundary: Measure repeated token/parse reduction versus descriptor/helper/relocation/call costs; diagnostic quality, peak RSS and whole request remain acceptance dimensions

duties.diagramLabel: Separate full bootstrap qualification from incremental development work
duties.concreteBoundary: from-scratch intentionally cleans/builds twice; the development path must reuse independently qualified Scheme-generated C and native objects by their actual input projections
duties.encodingRule: Generated C key owns compiler/semantic/source/effect closure; object key owns C/header-layout/toolchain/flags/target; link key owns ordered object/module/runtime closure
duties.cleanControl: Keep both target passes for current complete-bootstrap acceptance; a warm development result must not be relabeled full bootstrap
duties.failureMapping: ABI changes invalidate all real consumers; compiler-stage identity or unknown macro/eval/native reads may forbid generation reuse even if files look unchanged
duties.reflectionDuty: Bind no-change, runtime-leaf, shared-macro, frame-ABI, cancellation and failure outcomes; record eliminated work counts as well as elapsed time
duties.benefitBoundary: No-change should perform zero generation/compile/link on an exact admitted artifact; leaf edits must not trigger unrelated Scheme generation. These are design targets, not measured latency promises

duties.diagramLabel: One native composition owner; observed bytes are not admitted argv
duties.concreteBoundary: M4 now owns flag composition, capture defaults and BUILD templates; configure owns measured probes; native-profile.scm retains legacy fragments as octets
duties.encodingRule: C23 probe covers generated and runtime C; auto macro provenance compaction is restricted to Darwin GNU GCC, explicit unsupported requests fail
duties.cleanControl: Independent Scheme reader compares profile to actual make fields; both target bootstrap passes and map/GC still require current-source receipts
duties.failureMapping: legacy-opaque is never an empty argv vector; a profile emission or successful option probe cannot admit a managed executor or retire M8
duties.reflectionDuty: E01-E32, ordered overrides/duplicates, mode decoding and coherent installation remain necessary before all M8 consumers retire
duties.benefitBoundary: One configuration policy replaces duplicated composition ownership; diagnostic tracking savings differ from semantic token lowering and whole bootstrap latency

boundaries.invalidators: scheme-source; macro-read; compiler-stage; generation-option; generation-path; generation-effect
boundaries.inputProjection: GSC executable plus transitive Scheme/include/macro/eval/reader/native-read and output-effect closure; options, logical paths, stage identity and generated metadata
boundaries.reuseCondition: Completed producer, immutable output digests, complete stable read/effect snapshot and same generation stage; compiler host reuse does not imply target-C reuse
boundaries.refusal: Unknown dynamic input/effect, incompatible stage, partial phase, changed generated metadata or unproved path relocation
boundaries.workRemoved: Only a fully admitted generated-C artifact can remove generation; current full from-scratch still requires both target passes

boundaries.invalidators: generated-c; handwritten-c; header-abi; native-policy; native-toolchain; target
boundaries.inputProjection: Generated or handwritten C, actual headers/fragments/layouts, compiler/specs/SDK, target, ordered effective argv, cwd and relevant environment
boundaries.reuseCondition: Completed object under exact native projection; config policy changes invalidate affected objects without logically changing Scheme generation inputs
boundaries.refusal: Changed C23/macro policy, header ABI, compiler or unknown implicit native reads; broad configure identity must not be weakened to force a HIT
boundaries.workRemoved: Unchanged qualified objects may skip compilation; organizing a header alone removes no preprocessing or code generation

boundaries.inputProjection: Ordered objects/archive selection/module binding/runtime ABI, linker/SDK, link argv and observable output group
boundaries.reuseCondition: Complete successful link with current ordered dependency and binding identities; old compiler runtime is never linked into the new target
boundaries.refusal: Unknown or partial link, changed object/runtime/binding, or unproved natural-exit semantics
boundaries.workRemoved: Exact completed executable avoids relink; failed partial archives do not become a qualified runtime
